capabilities: Read Dayflow's chunks.sqlite database read-only and sync daily, weekly and yearly notes
Render inline SVG charts such as treemaps, heatmaps, Sankeys and week-over-week comparisons
Install three Bases dashboard files for recent days, weekly review and focus performance
Enrich timeline cards with per-app minutes from a local ActivityWatch instance
Detect Dayflow schema drift and stamp a callout into the existing Daily Note
extras: macOS-only and desktop-only; Dayflow.app must be installed and recording. Recommended install path is BRAT, i.e. not yet in the community plugin store. README documents privacy posture (read-only SQLite, no telemetry) and sigstore build attestations.
problem: Obsidian has no way to surface the screen-activity timeline recorded by the Dayflow app as notes, charts or dashboards inside the vault.

relations.evidence: This plugin reads Dayflow's chunks.sqlite read-only and writes daily + weekly notes into your vault
Flip a toggle to query your local ActivityWatch and get precise per-app minutes

summary: Reads Dayflow's local activity database read-only and generates daily, weekly and yearly notes with inline SVG charts and Bases dashboards.
